# HUD recharge countdown indicator

## Goal

A visible per-charge recharge countdown/timer indicator in the HUD for the Phase Shift and Teleport pools, so the player can read when an empty charge returns.

Recorded as out-of-scope during planning of AH-0MV2N0FX2004KEPR (Teleport and Phase Shift should recharge) — the recharge ACs only require the greyed-out empty state and the returning charge count; a countdown bar is a follow-up.

## Acceptance Criteria

- (To be refined at intake) A per-charge recharge countdown is visible in the HUD while a Phase Shift/Teleport charge is recharging.
